title: Network naming regex breaks Docker compatibility
body:
### Issue Description

When installing Sailfish SDK, I notice it creates a network name like: `sailfish-sdk:readefries`, which is allowed in Docker and on Podman, I get this error:

`Error: network name sailfish-sdk:readefries invalid: names must match [a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*: invalid argument`.

Since I wanted to figure out whether I could fix this myself and create a PR, the file explicitly states not to change the regex. Do you know the rationale _why_ this regex can't be changed so we can make it work just like Docker?

I would be more then happy to create a patch for this :)


### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Create a network with a name like `sailfish-sdk:readefries`
2. See the error

### Describe the results you received

Podman doesn't create a network and fails

### Describe the results you expected

Accept the same network names like Docker does
